reviews.title: Stop asking for money and signing me up before you give me a free trial
reviews.text:
I cannot trust an app without getting a demo. Plus, the question asked are not really unique - what is important to you, what parts do you want to focus, weight, height, goal weight! These are all very generic questions that almost free apps do already ask, and therefore not helpful. Yes, I do weigh 210 lbs at 5’11’’, but I have a lot of muscle.
Claiming this to be an AI fitness app, I’d expect some more intelligent/informative questions. And show me what the product is like before making me pay for a plan that I have no info on! Gemini, Claude, GPT-5 can do this stuff for free.

reviews.title: No unsubscribe button
reviews.text: I downloaded Fitness AI to compare it to the paid tiers of Fitbod and Hevy, and decided not to proceed with this app because it’s not differentiating enough from the others for the higher subscription fee, and I was turned off by the ad integration with the app. I signed up for the free trial, but there is no option in the app to unsubscribe. There is a “Delete my account” option, which I used, but it isn’t clear whether I will be charged when the free trial ends. This app does not appear in my Apple account Subscriptions list, and I only see it as a free “Purchase” in my Purchase History. There appears to be no option for me to confirm that I will not be charged by Fitness AI or Apple after the free trial ends, which helps me understand other reviewers’ frustration on this topic. The app developer should stop deflecting frustrated users to Apple when the developer is also responsible for this uncertainty on how to unsubscribe, and should inform their users on how to avoid subscription fees after the free trial ends.

reviews.title: DO NOT DOWNLOAD
reviews.text: To everybody reading this, I would urge you to do not download this app. From what I understand, it is completely AI ran. I tried canceling my subscription months ago and the app said that upon canceling my subscription all of my card info would be deleted. That was a complete lie because I just got charged another $20 randomly yesterday. They don’t even try to take money from me monthly they’ll just randomly charge you $19.99. This is a horrible app and I would recommend everybody stay away unless you want a headache trying to cancel your subscription and get these people to stop taking money from you. If anybody from the company related to this app would like to contact me, I would be happy to remove my negative review if we can get my situation resolved.

reviews.title: Super shady!!! Do not download!!!
reviews.text: I downloaded the app,  started the three day trial and then decided that it was not a good fit for me. When I went to cancel it, it was almost impossible. The website states that you either cancel it using the gear icon to get to membership settings In the app or your iCloud subscriptions. Neither were available for me. I ended up having to go to the Fitness AI website, pretend like I was creating a new account and when I put in the email, it said I already had an account. Then I was able to select manage account and it sent me a stripe link. This is garbage. If you want a way better app that will not try to trap you in a subscription choose Gravl. It has a straight forward subscription model and you can actually get a discount code.

reviews.title: Great for Beginners
reviews.text: I have been using this app for 4 months now.  As someone who has lifted for 12 years and worked out with a trainer I was looking for some variety in workouts I now structure myself.  I have found that it feeds the same exercises and either has 9 reps or 10 reps - it does not seem to be personalized - very cookie cutter. The options do lack some very basic exercises or machines and you can’t manually add.  I like to mix functional and compound exercises into my workout but not able to find many in the available exercises.  I would also like to make notes on the workout - how I felt or what I would like to do differently.  I will not be renewing my subscription.

reviews.title: THE ONE
reviews.text:
PLEASE STOP SHOWING ME ADS IN AN APP I PAY FOR


I have tried sooooo many fitness apps, and after 4 years, I think I have found that one that will make a difference. To give some context, I am a 21 year old male that is 140 pounds and I am looking to gain weight by building muscle. After only a month of using this app I am already noticing a difference, and people around me are too. This is such an incredibly rewarding tool. With most apps I would not follow through for multiple reasons: - complicated workouts - no results - incredibly difficult programs for my body type/beginner ability - programs that are too easy - cardio focused - terrible UI. FitnessAI solves ALL of the above problems with an easy to understand, body type focused workout that is displayed on a world class UI. Will update this review as I make more progress. The biggest thing with this app is to stick to a routine and work out every week! I workout 6 times a week currently but this may not stay the same! Update: watch support added! Please add calendar view widget to see active/inactive workout days Thank you developers Jack Update 2: up to 152lb, but according to my Fitbit scale my body fat percentage is around the same meaning I have gained 10lb of muscle
Update 3: !Feature request! Apple Watch working without the need of a nearby iPhone please :)
